attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools (T1562.001)
attackers_goals: Gain code execution on the host and evade security controls.
description: Windows Defender keeps the exclusion list in the registry, and any addition to it will cause it to ignore a process, path or file extension.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow. Check the excluded object type (process, path or extension) and nature. Check if the excluded object is malicious.
name: New addition to Windows Defender exclusion list
